positive_terms: Description of defined level of ambition to be achieved and of any qualitative or quantitative indicators used to evaluate progress
效果评估的预期水平与指标

Description of defined level of ambition to be achieved and of any qualitative or quantitative indicators used to evaluate progress。效果评估的预期水平与指标。按可持续主题、目标对象、基准年、目标期及范围复用；目标值、基准值和实际进展分开，整数类型提示不能强迫小数基准四舍五入。
